collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART V (81-100, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager fondly remembers the year it rained every day, though a friend remembers the complaining.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: "Remember the year it rained every single day?" (subject) says dreamily. "That was a wonderful year." (friend) stares at (subject.him/her). (friend) remembers that year very clearly. (friend.He/She) remembers (subject) complaining about it every single day.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "You hated it," says (friend). "You said the mud was trying to eat you." (subject) thinks about this. "I did say that," (subject.he/she) admits. "But we all sat inside and told stories, and the roof sang when the rain hit it." (friend) has to admit the roof did sing. Maybe both things are true.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) just nods. "It was quite a year." (subject) goes on about the stories, the singing roof and the smell of wet leaves. (friend) quietly decides that if (subject) can be this fond of a year (subject.he/she) complained about, there's hope for the current one.
